admin.depthHelp: How aggressively to fetch — deeper = more API calls + more results.

depthHint.quick: Fast preview — single query per source, no expansion. ~10 web · ~18 IG (1 hashtag) · ~50 TikTok · 15 FB · 20 directory.
depthHint.standard: Balanced default — single query per source, no expansion. Same per-call ceilings as quick, just higher dataset caps. ~20 web · ~18 IG (1 hashtag) · ~50 TikTok · 30 FB · 40 directory (2 pages).
depthHint.deep: Maximum coverage — GPT generates extra query variants and we union the results. Tavily: 4 variants × 20 = up to 100. IG: 5 related hashtags in a single Apify run (~90 posts → ~30-50 unique creators, since Apify's free tier caps each hashtag at one page). TikTok: 4 extra search queries. Facebook: 4 extra search queries (4 separate runs). Directories: walk 5 pages of pagination. Costs ~5× a standard run.
